title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock
description:
`prices[i]` is the price of a stock on day `i`. You may make **at most one trade**: buy one share on some day, then sell it on a **later** day.

Return the largest profit you can make. If no trade makes money, return `0`.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 3 at price 1 and sell on day 4 at price 6, for a profit of 5.
The price only falls, so the best choice is not to trade.
Buy at 2 on day 0 and sell at 4 on day 1. Buying at 1 on the last day leaves no day to sell.
